Retromobile Booth 634
Retromobile New York · Javits Center · 19 to 22 Nov 2026 · Luxury District

Official Merch Booth, Space 634

Floor plan and interactive 3D model. Triangle island, 42 ft by 42 ft by about 60 ft, on the Broadway diagonal, with 10 ft walls.

Reading the plan

North is up. Left leg faces 8th Avenue, the long side faces Broadway, the bottom faces 34th Street, as on the show map. Counter graphics alternate along each run: RM is the Retromobile logo, OM is OFFICIAL MERCH lettering. The corner wedge carries large OFFICIAL MERCH on both faces.

View
Wall height

Drag to orbit, scroll or pinch to zoom, right-drag to pan. Figures are 5 ft 10 in. Ceiling height is a placeholder because Javits does not publish one for these halls. Hall and furniture colors are a plain massing model, not final graphics.
